subject: AWS co-sell: Executive briefing + procurement pathway for Clearwell Health
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@clearwellhealth.com>
Cc: Kevin Park <kevin.park@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS co-sell: Executive briefing + procurement pathway for Clearwell Health

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Per our conversation, Clearwell's leadership wanted a short executive-level briefing that maps Redwood's managed inference + marketplace offer to your procurement timeline and security gate checklist.

I've looped in Kevin from AWS so we can align on the co-sell points and any AM/partner support. High-level asks from your side were: a one-hour exec briefing focused on business outcomes, a concise mutual-action-plan (MAP) for procurement, and a SOC2 / compliance summary for your security review.

I attached an initial MAP and SOC2 summary for context. Proposed next steps:
- Tue 9/16 or Wed 9/17: 45–60 minute exec briefing (product + commercial runway)
- Post-briefing: shared MAP with milestones for procurement/legal/compliance

Do either of those dates work for you? If yes, which time window (morning PT / afternoon PT)?

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: RW_Clearwell_MAP_v0.9.xlsx (spreadsheet - MAP draft), SOC2_summary_2025.pdf (pdf)
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@clearwellhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Javier Morales <j.morales@clearwell.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell: Executive briefing + procurement pathway for Clearwell Health

Mina —

Thanks, this looks aligned to what we discussed. 9/16 is preferred for the exec briefing; morning PT around 10:00 PT would work for our CTO (Javier) and Head of Procurement.

A couple quick asks before the briefing:
- Can you include a single-slide summary of expected unit economics (eg. per-conversation cost ranges) for the two likely usage profiles we mentioned?
- Any examples of Marketplace contract language we should expect (pricing term, seat vs usage model)?

I'll block 10:00–11:00 PT 9/16 tentatively and add Javier. Please confirm and send calendar invite.

Appreciate it —
Samantha
VP, Digital Platforms | Clearwell Health
Samantha.lee@clearwellhealth.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell: Exec brief for Clearwell - prep items

Mina / Lauren —

Quick internal sync points after reviewing the MAP:
- Mina: can you add a one-slide cost sensitivity table (low/typical/high token volumes) so procurement can see upside of reserved vs hosted paths?
- Lauren: legal will ask about data residency and logging. Please have our standard Marketplace SOW excerpt and the data-processing addendum ready; also confirm whether Private/VPC options are on the table for them.
- I'll coordinate AWS co-sell talking points with Kevin; want to highlight any incentives or credits available for joint customers.

Let's aim to have a 30-min internal run on Wed 9/15 at 11:00 PT to align before the customer briefing. Confirm availability.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@clearwellhealth.com>, Kevin Park <kevin.park@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:21:00 -0700
Subject: RE: AWS co-sell: Executive briefing + procurement pathway for Clearwell Health

All —

Thanks for the quick replies. Confirming calendars:
- Internal run (Redwood only): Wed 9/15 11:00–11:30 PT — Mina/Karthik/Lauren (invite sent).
- Customer exec briefing: Thu 9/16 10:00–11:00 PT — Mina, Karthik, Kevin joining; Samantha and Javier from Clearwell. Calendar invite attached.

Attachments updated: added "RW_Clearwell_MAP_v1.0.xlsx" (minor edits) and a one-slide cost sensitivity exported as PDF. Also attached a Marketplace contract excerpt for procurement to review (filename: RW_marketplace_terms_excerpt.docx).

Samantha: per your ask, the single-slide unit economics is included. We will present a clean cost-comparison table (hosted pay-as-you-go vs reserved Dedicated vs Private) and three usage scenarios.

Kevin: if AWS has any co-sell incentives we should call out during the briefing, please drop a short note or slide here so we can fold it into the deck.

Mina

Attachments: RW_Clearwell_MAP_v1.0.xlsx; RW_unit_econ_preview.pdf; RW_marketplace_terms_excerpt.docx
From: Kevin Park <kevin.park@amazon.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@clearwellhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell: Executive briefing + procurement pathway for Clearwell Health

Mina / Team / Samantha —

Appreciate the invite. We can confirm a small co-sell credit that applies to first 3 months of committed Dedicated capacity for healthcare customers that meet the program criteria. I'll be prepared to outline the eligibility and a proposed timeline in the briefing.

Also, quick note on procurement language: AWS prefers a term where the partner (Redwood) provides the software license and AWS is the transacting party for the marketplace listing; we'll note typical contract redlines and how that affects invoicing.

See you all at 10:00 PT.

- Kevin
AWS Partner Manager
kevin.park@amazon.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@clearwellhealth.com>, Javier Morales <j.morales@clearwell.com>, Kevin Park <kevin.park@amazon.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: AWS co-sell: Executive briefing + procurement pathway for Clearwell Health — follow-up and MAP

Team —

Thanks again for a productive briefing this morning. Quick follow-ups captured during the call and next milestones (from the MAP):
1) Legal/procurement: Clearwell to confirm whether they want Redwood to transact via AWS Marketplace or via direct SOW (procurement asked for both options by EOD Mon 9/20). Owner: Samantha.
2) Technical: Redwood to provide short doc for data residency options and Private deployment checklist. Owner: Lauren. Due Thu 9/23.
3) Commercial: Redwood to provide a draft one-year quote with both pay-as-you-go and reserved Dedicated options. Owner: Mina. Due Fri 9/24.
4) AWS incentives: Kevin to confirm co-sell credit eligibility and estimated timeline (by Tue 9/21).

I've uploaded the finalized MAP to the Drive link in the related_links above and attached the meeting notes and action tracker. Please acknowledge your assigned actions so we can mark the MAP progress.

Samantha — appreciate you coordinating procurement's interest in both contracting paths. Let us know preference by EOD 9/20 so we can prepare the correct SOW.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai

Attachments: Clearwell_exec_brief_notes_20260917.docx; RW_Clearwell_MAP_v1.1.xlsx
